structure.name: Building Activity
structure.description: Dataset: BUILDING_ACTIVITY. Building Activity. Provides estimates of value of building work and number of dwellings commenced, completed, under construction and in the pipeline. Unit of measure: AUD Units. Geographic coverage: Australia/State. Catalogue number: 8752.0
